summary: community.hrobot renamed the robot inventory plugin's filters option to simple_filters; the old name stops working in community.hrobot 2.0.0.
questions: What should I rename filters to in the hrobot inventory?
Will filters stop working in community.hrobot 2?

answer_card.title: hrobot inventory: filters → simple_filters
answer_card.answer_md: In the `community.hrobot.robot` inventory config, rename **`filters:`** to **`simple_filters:`**. The old name stops working in **community.hrobot 2.0.0**.
